ING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help of over 2000 high-performing engineers, risk, and operations professionals. We started out in 2015 as ING’s software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities and operate in Bucharest. Our tech capabilities remain the core of our business, with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data Management, Touchpoint Channels & Integration, Core Banking, and Global Products. We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged. For us, impact isnt a perk. Its the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you?

Heres a sneak peak of what our colleagues say about working within ING Hubs Romania:At ING, were building the solutions of tomorrow, today | 80% of our colleagues in Romania agreeThe MissionRetail & Banking Technology (R&BT) provides common technology capabilities, frameworks, platforms, and reusable product services that ING entities can use to build local customer propositions. Its capabilities are designed for reuse across countries, customer segments, channels, and products.Its responsibilities include:Providing foundational capabilities, a strong data foundation, and reusable product engines and services.Managing a portfolio of global products and services and setting standards for their providers.Coordinating demand from countries with supply from global providers, including alignment of priorities and roadmaps.Supporting the integration and pre-integration of global services into local propositions.Promoting reuse across countries, channels, and customer segments.Ensuring that the components of our scalable products work together consistently and are easy for consumers to integrate.The IT Integrator for R&BT is responsible for the coordination and management of large-scale, cross-domain IT initiatives within R&BT. This role acts as a strategic bridge between business and IT, ensuring the successful, timely, and cost-effective delivery of complex IT solutions that support R&BTs mission and objectives. The IT Integrator drives collaboration, oversees project governance, and facilitates the implementation of technology-driven change across multiple teams, tribes, and organizational boundaries.Your day to dayEven if youll start your day from the comfort of your home or drink your morning coffee in our offices garden, your day will be quite similar when it comes to tasks.
